semiconductor_relevance: High — OHLABS provides advanced non-destructive inspection solutions crucial for semiconductor packaging and wafer inspection.
summary: OHLABS CO. specializes in high-frequency ultrasound inspection technology for the semiconductor industry, offering non-destructive internal defect visualization solutions. Their FSAM-400 Live Scan system is designed for detecting subsurface voids, cracks, and delaminations in semiconductor packaging, enhancing defect detection capabilities beyond traditional optical methods.
capabilities: Subsurface defect detection in semiconductor packaging
technical_expertise: Acoustic hardware and laser ultrasound direction
